decision.reason: [ev-0bb0d885678d] is a one-line feature note. It says only that "service/servicemon definitions" now use port names instead of numbers, and otherwise points to PR #7727. It does not say which chart templates or components are involved, which field changed (for example a Service targetPort or a ServiceMonitor endpoint port), what the port names are, or which values key controls the change. So the subject cannot be typed without guessing. Getting the PR #7727 diff or the rendered chart manifests from before and after the change would fill this gap.
